title: Tajik — passport-style ASCII (English-style)
authority: No published table; modelled on official English spellings and observed passport names
description: Tajik Cyrillic names in English/passport ASCII: Ғ→GH, Ӣ→I, Қ→Q, Ӯ→U, Ҳ→H, Ҷ→J, Х→KH, Ж→ZH, Й→Y, Ё/Ю/Я→YO/YU/YA, Ъ dropped, Е→E (Эмомалӣ Раҳмон → Emomali Rahmon, Сироҷиддин Муҳриддин → Sirojiddin Muhriddin).
notes: No primary source on Tajik passport transliteration was found; status informal. The letter choices follow the research notes' English-style profile and official English names (Emomali Rahmon, Sirojiddin Muhriddin).

Older passports and Russian-form documents follow the Russian ICAO table via Russian spellings: Ҷ→DZH (Джамшед → Dzhamshed), Ҳ→KH (Fatkhullo, Manuchekhr), Қ→K, Ӣ→I/II, О→A in Russified stems (Рахмонов). Generate these as variants, plus Ғ→G, Ӯ→O/OO, Ӣ→EE/IY.
Surname law of 2016 bans -ov/-ev/-ovich/-ovna for new registrations (-zoda, -zod, -ī, -yon, -far, -pur instead); expect Rahmonov ↔ Rahmon ↔ Rahmonzoda.
Pre-1998 letters ц, щ, ь, ы fall back to the Russian ICAO values.
